problem_class.label: convex
problem_class.details: Unconstrained minimization of a differentiable convex function f on a real Hilbert space. A minimizer x⋆ exists with ‖x0−x⋆‖≤R and f(x0)−f(x⋆)≤Δ. Strong convexity is not assumed.

oracle.label: inexact_gradient
oracle.details: A query x returns g satisfying ‖g−∇f(x)‖≤α‖∇f(x)‖ for every history and seed. Replies may be biased and history-dependent; neither independence nor unbiasedness is required. No function values are supplied.

distinctive_assumptions.label: generalized_smoothness
distinctive_assumptions.details: The gradient is continuous. Whenever ‖∇f(x+θ(y−x))‖≤M for every θ∈[0,1], one has ‖∇f(x)−∇f(y)‖≤(L0+L1M)‖x−y‖. Public parameters satisfy L0>0 and L1≥0; no second differentiability is assumed.

distinctive_assumptions.label: relative_error
distinctive_assumptions.details: The public error tolerance satisfies 0≤α≤1/100. The relative gradient-error bound holds pointwise for every query, history, and seed, including adversarially dependent errors.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: The ambient space is an arbitrary complete real inner-product space, without a finite-dimensional restriction. E, x0, L0, L1, R, Δ, α, and ε are public, with R, Δ, ε>0; f and its gradient are hidden instance data.

accuracy.label: objective_gap
accuracy.details: Return a point x with f(x)−f(x⋆)≤ε for a global minimizer x⋆, within the supplied fixed budget of inexact-gradient oracle calls.
accuracy.evidence: LongTails/Setups/RelativeGeneralizedSmoothConvex.lean: spec.successful; LongTails/Template.lean: Convergence, executeWithTrace; supplied extracted result budget.

accuracy.label: almost_sure
accuracy.details: The output objective-gap guarantee holds almost surely under the joint law of algorithm and oracle seeds.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: The setup combines gradient-dependent generalized smoothness with uniformly bounded, potentially adversarial relative gradient error in an arbitrary Hilbert space, and requires almost-sure objective accuracy within a fixed oracle budget.
